title: OWASP Top 10 2021
description: Public OWASP Top 10 category snapshot used as a high-level compliance/risk lens. This is a category-level ruleset, not a substitute for detailed ASVS verification rows.

rows.title: Broken Access Control
rows.description: Access control weaknesses that allow users to act outside their intended permissions.

rows.title: Cryptographic Failures
rows.description: Failures related to protection of data in transit or at rest, including exposure of sensitive data or secrets.

rows.title: Injection
rows.description: Injection weaknesses where untrusted input can alter commands, queries, interpreters, or structured output.

rows.title: Insecure Design
rows.description: Design-level weaknesses where required security controls, threat modelling, or abuse-case protections are absent.

rows.title: Security Misconfiguration
rows.description: Unsafe or incomplete security configuration across application, platform, headers, services, or dependencies.

rows.title: Vulnerable and Outdated Components
rows.description: Known vulnerable, unsupported, or outdated components that increase exploitability or operational risk.

rows.title: Identification and Authentication Failures
rows.description: Authentication, session, credential, identity, or account lifecycle weaknesses.

rows.title: Software and Data Integrity Failures
rows.description: Integrity weaknesses in software updates, CI/CD, deserialization, supply chain, or trusted data flows.

rows.title: Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
rows.description: Insufficient logging, monitoring, alerting, incident visibility, or auditability.

rows.title: Server-Side Request Forgery
rows.description: Server-side request forgery weaknesses that allow attacker-controlled server-side requests.
